text: Independent re-check of the chemistry curation: 112 identifiers retrieved and confirmed, 3 errors found, 3 claims unverifiable. Verdict ACCEPT_WITH_CORRECTIONS.
[minor] Ginsenoside Rg1 (CID 441923) molecular_weight — claimed: 801.01 / actual: RDKit Descriptors.MolWt = 801.024 (rounds to 801.02); PubChem reports 801.0. The value 801.01 matches neither source.

[minor] Huperzine A note - stated cause of the platform SMILES parse failure — claimed: the platform SMILES 'CC1=CC2C(=C)C3C(=O)NC(=C2CC3(C)N)C' FAILS to parse in RDKit (kekulization error) / actual: It does fail to parse, but RDKit's error is 'SMILES Parse Error: unclosed ring for input' - ring-closure bond 1 is opened and never closed. Not a kekulization error. Conclusion correct, diagnosis wrong.

[minor] Ginkgolide B note - atom-count difference between platform SMILES and true structure — claimed: missing one lactone ring (C2O2) from the true tri-gamma-lactone cage / actual: Verified delta is C2H2O2, not C2O2: platform SMILES parses to C18H22O8 (MW 366.37) vs true C20H24O10 (MW 424.40). The hydrogens are omitted from the stated difference.
